Azure Pipelines task retirement: all 4 tasks

Azure Pipelines tasks are retired on 2026-10-15 and removed on 2027-03-15. Pipelines that still use a removed task fail. Find your task below and open its page for migration guidance.

Questions

When are the Azure Pipelines tasks retired and removed?

They are retired on 2026-10-15 and removed on 2027-03-15. Pipelines that still use a removed task fail.

How many task versions does this site cover?

4 task versions, one page each, with their replacement and the migration effort.

Can trasloco fix it automatically?

Not available yet. Use the plain grep command on each task page.

About trasloco

trasloco is an open-source command-line tool that finds retired Azure Pipelines tasks. CI/CD pipeline migration is planned. This site is generated from its catalog. Machine-readable versions: Atom feed, llms.txt, llms-full.txt and modernize.json.

Last verified: 2026-10-12. Facts are generated from the trasloco catalog; the full data is in modernize.json.

trasloco is an open-source project. Source code and issues.
